description: Ticket 04 worst-case 12x12 editor board (open grid, sparse regions): rows 0-9 are one region each, region 10 is the single cell (10,0), region 11 the single cell (11,1); every other cell of rows 10-11 is region 0. The two single-cell regions touch, so there is no solution and an unbudgeted limit=2 search must enumerate every no-touch 10-row column arrangement before answering None. Slowest of 29 offline candidates (single-cell traps, row/column bands, big-blob, 20 random sparse boards).
unbudgetedNote: QueensSearch.bounded(limit=2) on a cold Apple-silicon JVM test run, 2026-11-06; trap variants at other columns ran 4.0-4.5 s
